title: SourceRecord
description: Schema for a single source record in a research run. Stored in sources.jsonl (one JSON object per line). Phase 6B adds optional fetch fields populated by the owner-gated fetcher.

source_id.description: Unique identifier for this source within the run. Format: src-NNN or source-NNN.

url.description: Original URL of the source, or null for offline sources.

final_url.description: URL after following redirects, or null when not yet fetched. Phase 6B.

source_type.description: Type of source, from the allowed source types in the source quality policy. 'official_docs' is the short form used in pending-sources.json and is accepted as an alias for 'official_documentation'.

trust_level.description: Trust level assigned to this source.

fetched_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the source was fetched, or null if not yet fetched.

published_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the source was published, or null if unknown.

last_modified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last modification, or null if unknown.

http_status.description: HTTP status code from the fetch exchange, or null when not yet fetched. Phase 6B.

content_type.description: Response Content-Type from the fetch exchange, or null. Phase 6B.

bytes_saved.description: Number of bytes of the response body saved to disk, or null. Phase 6B.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the saved response body, or null. Phase 6B.

artifact_path.description: Path relative to the run directory of the saved response artifact (e.g. fetched/source-001/response.html), or null. Phase 6B.

author.description: Author or authors of the source.

summary.description: Brief summary of the source content (written after fetching).

notes_path.description: Relative path to detailed source notes file, or null.

skip_reason.description: Reason for skipping if status is 'skipped'.

paywalled.description: Whether this source is behind a paywall.

metadata.description: Additional metadata specific to this source type.
